svg.text: The finite-D harmonic ratios' D = ∞ limits against the tuned profile
r_ν = F_(ν+2)/F_ν of the centre profile, fitted in ε = 1/(D − 1) over the full-system states D 15–73 (r₁ also the chain to D 215), extrapolated to ε = 0.
r₁ and r₃ settle on the tuned values. r₅ and r₇ are still moving toward them as the degree grows, the sign of a singularity nearer to ε = 0 than the data reach.
Polynomial fit: distance of its limit from the tuned ratio
D = ∞ limit: polynomial grid against rational shapes
rational: (r − c)/ε = P_L/Q_M, [L/M] = [3/3], [4/3], [5/3], [4/4], left to right
